title: introduce-typed-abort-and-named-backoff-presets-across-sdks
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds AbortToken cancel hint and BackoffProfiles presets across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs; minor version bumps. Backwards compatible by default.
description: Motivation: teams using polyglot services reported inconsistent cancelation ergonomics and subtly different retry/backoff configuration across SDKs. This PR standardizes a small, typed AbortToken abstraction and a named backoff profile surface (fast, balanced, conservative) across Python, TypeScript, and Go. The change is ergonomic and additive; legacy config continues to work. Key changes: Python: add redwood.sdk.abort.AbortToken and redwood.sdk.backoff.Profiles; streams accept optional abort_token. TypeScript: export AbortToken type and BackoffProfiles in top-level package; streaming AsyncIterable constructors accept an abortToken. Go: introduce abortkit.AbortToken and backoff.Profiles struct; streaming client accepts ctx plus optional AbortToken. Shared artifacts: canonical JSON schema for backoff profiles and shared test vectors used in SDK unit tests. Ergonomics: cancelable streaming facades with concise examples, migration helpers to wrap legacy config into named profiles. Version bumps: python-sdk -> 3.4.0, typescript-sdk -> 2.2.0, go-sdk -> 1.7.3. Docs: cross-SDK quickstart demonstrating identical cancel semantics. The server contract is unchanged; AbortToken is advisory and non-serializable.
